initial_frame.baseline: The existing read called resolve_artifact_ref, which verified the complete blob, before checking the byte limit; it then called unbounded Path.read_bytes.
constraints: Canonical registry only; no new storage or replay database
Preserve public complete-artifact resolve/verify behavior and historical ArtifactRef semantics
No dispatch, installation, network access, runtime pin invention or production qualification
initial_frame.observable: A 65,537-byte blob under a 65,536-byte limit raises ArtifactSizeLimitError without content read or full hash; valid within-bound blobs retain exact content/provenance and corrupt blobs reject.
initial_frame.question: Does read_artifact_ref(max_bytes) bound blob IO before full hashing and still return only exact verified bytes?

local_validation.counts_overlap: The 30 monitoring contract tests are included in the 216-case Wilborn suite. The nine new registry tests are included in the 25 registry tests.

wilborn_suite.final_delta_coverage: After the final narrow SQL/catalogue predicate, the complete 25 registry and 30 focused monitoring tests passed. The 216-case suite was not redundantly rerun, following root review direction.
wilborn_suite.reason: The shared canonical read path is used by existing Wilborn artifact/research workflows; this is a concrete compatibility check.

continuum.reason: No continuous approximation or physical performance model is used.

fuzzy.reason: Neither size nor integrity is a graded authorization condition.

n_ality.reason: Registered identity, actual descriptor size, byte limit, digest and mutation state are independent checks; any failing axis rejects.

simplex.reason: The byte limit is an exact integer gate, not a convex allocation.

remaining: Review exact runtime/dependency closure and execution-adapter identities
Implement and independently inspect aggregate CPU/memory/process/storage limits, private mounts/network loopback and whole-group cleanup
Reconcile exact executable wrapper, candidate inputs, runtime and reviewed test-case inventory before profile installation
Perform actual fixed-profile ARM64 acceptance through a separately authorized installed route
Retain independent operational custody, private-host recovery and release evidence gates
repair: Factor existing immutable version/current/provenance lookup into a private metadata helper that marks its result unverified and performs no blob IO.

Require the corresponding artifacts catalogue row, digest-derived canonical relative path and matching catalogue/version sizes before opening a blob; missing or inconsistent metadata cannot bypass the old catalogue-membership condition.

Keep public resolve_artifact_ref and verify_artifact as complete-artifact verification operations for valid inputs; bounded read no longer calls them first. Normal valid-artifact results and provenance are preserved; resolution additionally rejects corrupt catalogue paths and inconsistent catalogue/version sizes.
Open one regular-file descriptor and check both registered size and actual fstat size before any content stream, read or hash.
Use raw unbuffered IO capped at max_bytes plus one overflow-detection byte; reject oversized returned content before hashing.
Verify exact registered length, SHA-256 and unchanged descriptor identity/size/timestamps on the same bytes before setting verified=true.
Close the descriptor on success, oversize, corruption, mutation and IO failure; retain ArtifactSizeLimitError for budget rejection and chained RuntimeError for unavailable blob IO.
